title: Hierarchical H-tree global clock distribution topology
decision: Adopted a balanced hierarchical H-tree for global clock distribution to minimize skew
rationale: Achieve sub-10-ps clock skew to support multi-GHz operation across the large die
outcome: Successfully met clock skew targets for high-frequency synchronization
weakest_point: exact skew value and whether H-tree was explicitly compared to alternatives

title: Copper interconnect for upper metal layers in power grid
decision: Used copper for upper metal layers in the power distribution network
rationale: Reduce resistance and improve electromigration reliability for high current density
outcome: Enabled higher current carrying capacity and reduced IR drop in the power grid
weakest_point: exact metal layers where copper was introduced

title: Corner-based static timing analysis with OCV derating
decision: Employed corner-based static timing analysis with on-chip variation (OCV) derating
rationale: Account for manufacturing variations while maintaining computational tractability for full-chip timing closure
outcome: Achieved timing closure with acceptable margins across all operational corners
weakest_point: specific OCV derating factors and corner models used

title: Symmetrical floorplan for L2 cache and processor cores
decision: Adopted a symmetrical floorplan with L2 cache arrays surrounding processor cores
rationale: Optimize wire lengths, reduce latency, and balance thermal distribution
outcome: Minimized average memory access latency and improved thermal uniformity
weakest_point: exact floorplan configuration and whether alternatives were explicitly evaluated

title: Shielding and spacing rules for critical signal nets
decision: Implemented strict shielding and minimum spacing rules for critical signal nets
rationale: Prevent crosstalk-induced delays in high-frequency critical paths
outcome: Reduced noise-related timing failures to acceptable levels
weakest_point: specific shielding implementation details and which nets were protected
